# InterFPGA_Spike_Routing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The mechanism for routing spike events between FPGAs in a multi-FPGA SNN system, often using high-speed serial links or network-on-chip protocols. Critical for maintaining low-latency, high-throughput spike delivery across chips, directly impacting network performance and real-time processing.
